A wonderful shooter that reminds me of a Contra game. Each character has their own weapons and styles of play, and you explore each radomly generated planet destroying creatures, collecting currency, and buying new weapons and power ups. This sounds very basic right now, like every game, the more you grind the more powerful you become, but here's the twist: The longer you play the harder the game gets. While other games get harder by level, this game gets more difficult according to the timer. Now you have to find the balance between getting stronger and not giving the enemy the advantage.

Throw in the fact that you can play with 3 other friends for 4 player action and you've got yourself a really fun game. The distance from the main character to the screen is a bit strange at first but this is to maximize how much screen the 4 players can share. Another hiccup is this is one of the games I own where getting the multiplayer to work properly was the most difficult. Other than that though, do not pass this game up if you're looking for some old school side scrolling shooting action to enjoy with your friends. You cannot beat this price and you're going to enjoy severalseveral hours and multiple play throughs unlocking and exploring all the characters you can use.

If you buy Risk of Rain, prepare to run like hell. Its a 2d rogue like side scroller, with replay value. There are  ton of classes to choose from,and it will take a while to find one that fits your style. At first i loved the enforcer for his turtle style gameplay, but i found it would take too long for me to finish levels, which isn't good because time is your enemy here. You can choose to move at a slow pace collecting power more powerups, or run straight to the boss. The only thing i don't like about this it, is the hassle that goes with setting up online co op. I did however play it couch co op with a friend, which was fun. If you want a good rogue like, try it out.
